name: e2fsprogs
description: The E2fsprogs package contains the utilities for handling the ext2 file system. It also supports the ext3 and ext4 journaling file systems.

installed_descriptions.name: badblocks
installed_descriptions.description: Searches a device (usually a disk partition) for bad blocks

installed_descriptions.name: chattr
installed_descriptions.description: Changes the attributes of files on ext{{234}} file systems

installed_descriptions.name: compile_et
installed_descriptions.description: An error table compiler; it converts a table of error-code names and messages into a C source file suitable for use with the com_err library

installed_descriptions.name: debugfs
installed_descriptions.description: A file system debugger; it can be used to examine and change the state of ext{{234}} file systems

installed_descriptions.name: dumpe2fs
installed_descriptions.description: Prints the super block and blocks group information for the file system present on a given device

installed_descriptions.name: e2freefrag
installed_descriptions.description: Reports free space fragmentation information

installed_descriptions.name: e2fsck
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to check and optionally repair ext{{234}} file systems

installed_descriptions.name: e2image
installed_descriptions.description: Is used to save critical ext{{234}} file system data to a file

installed_descriptions.name: e2label
installed_descriptions.description: Displays or changes the file system label on the ext{{234}} file system on a given device

installed_descriptions.name: e2mmpstatus
installed_descriptions.description: Checks MMP (Multiple Mount Protection) status of an ext4 file system

installed_descriptions.name: e2scrub
installed_descriptions.description: Checks the contents of a mounted ext{{234}} file system

installed_descriptions.name: e2scrub_all
installed_descriptions.description: Checks all mounted ext{{234}} file systems for errors

installed_descriptions.name: e2undo
installed_descriptions.description: Replays the undo log for an ext{{234}} file system found on a device. [This can be used to undo a failed operation by an E2fsprogs program.]

installed_descriptions.name: e4crypt
installed_descriptions.description: Ext4 file system encryption utility

installed_descriptions.name: e4defrag
installed_descriptions.description: Online defragmenter for ext4 file systems

installed_descriptions.name: filefrag
installed_descriptions.description: Reports on how badly fragmented a particular file might be

installed_descriptions.name: fsck.ext2
installed_descriptions.description: By default checks ext2 file systems and is a hard link to e2fsck

installed_descriptions.name: fsck.ext3
installed_descriptions.description: By default checks ext3 file systems and is a hard link to e2fsck

installed_descriptions.name: fsck.ext4
installed_descriptions.description: By default checks ext4 file systems and is a hard link to e2fsck

installed_descriptions.name: logsave
installed_descriptions.description: Saves the output of a command in a log file

installed_descriptions.name: lsattr
installed_descriptions.description: Lists the attributes of files on a second extended file system

installed_descriptions.name: mk_cmds
installed_descriptions.description: Converts a table of command names and help messages into a C source file suitable for use with the libss subsystem library

installed_descriptions.name: mke2fs
installed_descriptions.description: Creates an ext{{234}} file system on the given device

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs.ext2
installed_descriptions.description: By default creates ext2 file systems and is a hard link to mke2fs

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs.ext3
installed_descriptions.description: By default creates ext3 file systems and is a hard link to mke2fs

installed_descriptions.name: mkfs.ext4
installed_descriptions.description: By default creates ext4 file systems and is a hard link to mke2fs

installed_descriptions.name: mklost+found
installed_descriptions.description: Creates a lost+found directory on an ext{{234}} file system; it pre-allocates disk blocks to this directory to lighten the task of e2fsck

installed_descriptions.name: resize2fs
installed_descriptions.description: Can be used to enlarge or shrink ext{{234}} file systems

installed_descriptions.name: tune2fs
installed_descriptions.description: Adjusts tunable file system parameters on ext{{234}} file systems

installed_descriptions.name: libcom_err
installed_descriptions.description: The common error display routine

installed_descriptions.name: libe2p
installed_descriptions.description: Used by dumpe2fs, chattr, and lsattr

installed_descriptions.name: libext2fs
installed_descriptions.description: Contains routines to enable user-level programs to manipulate ext{{234}} file systems

installed_descriptions.name: libss
installed_descriptions.description: Used by debugfs
